image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned on a light beige surface. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a reddish-pink to purplish-brown coloration and lighter mottled spots. Two large chelipeds (claws) are visible at the front, with dark tips. Several walking legs extend laterally from the sides of the carapace. The image appears to be a scan from an older biological illustration or textbook, indicated by the paper texture and faint text in the upper right background.
